role_evidence.quote: Lerapolturev (5x10\^7 TCID50) delivered intratumorally via convection enhanced delivery (CED).
LUMINOS-101: Lerapolturev (PVSRIPO) and Pembrolizumab in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

agents.drug_class_hint: recombinant oncolytic poliovirus (PVSRIPO), intratumoral convection-enhanced delivery

coder_notes: Single-arm trial of an oncolytic poliovirus (excluded type) plus pembrolizumab. Pembrolizumab is the only non-excluded investigational agent, so experimental_monotherapy per the pembrolizumab plus vaccine example; regimen coded combination because the virus is a second antitumour agent. Poliovirus and tetanus booster vaccinations required before treatment are preparatory, not registered interventions, so not listed. MGMT is mentioned only as prior-therapy history, not as a biomarker requirement.
